		843 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { is_controlled_by = var:_rt_anchor CONTROLLER = { OR = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor is_subject_of = var:_rt_anchor var:_rt_anchor = { is_subject_of = PREV } OVERLORD = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor } } } } } }
			CONTROLLER = { log = "    corridor 8 BLOCKED at state 843 by [This.GetName]" }
		} }
		838 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { is_controlled_by = var:_rt_anchor CONTROLLER = { OR = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor is_subject_of = var:_rt_anchor var:_rt_anchor = { is_subject_of = PREV } OVERLORD = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor } } } } } }
			CONTROLLER = { log = "    corridor 8 BLOCKED at state 838 by [This.GetName]" }
		} }
		839 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { is_controlled_by = var:_rt_anchor CONTROLLER = { OR = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor is_subject_of = var:_rt_anchor var:_rt_anchor = { is_subject_of = PREV } OVERLORD = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor } } } } } }
			CONTROLLER = { log = "    corridor 8 BLOCKED at state 839 by [This.GetName]" }
		} }
		465 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { is_controlled_by = var:_rt_anchor CONTROLLER = { OR = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor is_subject_of = var:_rt_anchor var:_rt_anchor = { is_subject_of = PREV } OVERLORD = { is_in_faction_with = var:_rt_anchor } } } } } }
			CONTROLLER = { log = "    corridor 8 BLOCKED at state 465 by [This.GetName]" }
		} }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_railway_connection = { start_province = 1843 target_province = 7361 } }
		log = "    corridor 8: endpoint rail connection = YES"
	}
	else = {
		log = "    corridor 8: endpoint rail connection = NO"
	}
	log = "=== RAIL CORRIDOR TEST END ==="
}
